line: US vinyl sales in 2025. The first billion-dollar year since 1983, and the 19th straight year of growth.

head: Black Friday is Nov. 27
line: The RSD Black Friday exclusives are out. Live sets, reissues and first-time pressings, only at independent stores.

head: The Beat's crates are back
line: Fat Elephant Records opened a second shop in Folsom, CA, stocked with leftover inventory from Sacramento's The Beat. Records run $3 to $10.

head: New home on Main Street
line: The Vinyl Café in Longmont, CO moved to 704 Main Street to keep up with demand from collectors.

head: Go dig this weekend.
line: Tell us your local record store. We'll share the list.
US CD sales in the first half of 2026: 16.3 million units. Vinyl grew 2.3%. Don't sleep on the CD bins.
